comparison.objective: Open an energized fuse cutout with a hotstick and leave the tube hanging; candidate tunes an isolated axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-tool ring engagement and remote pulling versus close bimanual hex-key/collar manipulation followed by guarded actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Cutout opened using the hotstick without unsafe reach versus two safe carriage stops with no setting drift.
comparison.reason: Tool-mediated electrical switching is materially different from mechanical damping adjustment. Exact clearance and hanging-angle thresholds are not provided.
